results.title: Protect College Sports Act gains Senate approval in bipartisan vote
results.description: The Protect College Sports Act took its next step forward on Monday, with the Senate voting overwhelmingly 77-22 in favor of the proposed federal legislation reforming college athletics.

results.title: The Gazette's Week 4 high school football power rankings
results.description: The Week 4-slate proved very consequential to The Gazette’s latest Section 2 football power rankings, as several teams found themselves moving up in the polls, while others held tightly to their top spots, after some big-time wins.
